book.title: 今天我是大班值日生
book.subtitle: 照顾班级植物角与分发餐具

moral.zh: 服务大家是一件神气的事；不小心洒了水没关系，擦干净依然是最棒的值日生。
moral.en: Helping everyone feels wonderful; spilling water is okay, and wiping it clean makes a truly responsible helper.

pages.zhText: 今天一进大班教室，林老师就在黑板的值日表上插上了安安和天天的小照片。
pages.enText: Stepping into the senior classroom today, Teacher Lin placed photo cards of An'an and Tiantian onto the duty roster.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Bright classroom morning view: wooden blackboard with duty board; Teacher Lin places An'an's photo card into the top slot.
pages.generationPrompt: Bright classroom morning view: wooden blackboard with duty board; Teacher Lin places An'an's photo card into the top slot.

pages.zhText: 林老师给安安的胳膊套上印着金色小星的红袖标：“今天你是大班值日生哦！”安安挺起小胸脯，心里格外神气。
pages.enText: Teacher Lin slipped a red armband with a golden star onto An'an's sleeve. “Today you are our helper!” An'an stood tall, feeling proud.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium shot: Teacher Lin fits red badge onto An'an's teal hoodie sleeve; An'an stands tall with joyful beaming pride.
pages.generationPrompt: Medium shot: Teacher Lin fits red badge onto An'an's teal hoodie sleeve; An'an stands tall with joyful beaming pride.

pages.zhText: 第一项任务是照顾走廊阳台旁的班级植物角。窗台上有几盆吊兰，还有两盆绿油油的大叶绿萝。
pages.enText: The first task was tending the class plant corner by the sunny veranda: hanging spider plants and lush green pothos pots.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Veranda plant corner view: sunlight streaming onto wooden shelves filled with potted green plants and blooming flowers.
pages.generationPrompt: Veranda plant corner view: sunlight streaming onto wooden shelves filled with potted green plants and blooming flowers.
pages.provenanceNote: Earlier import retained only the scene prompt. The full provider prompt was not recorded; it is not reconstructed as provenance.

pages.zhText: 安安接来一小喷壶清水，认认真真地给绿萝的叶子喷水。小水珠落在翠绿的叶面上，像一颗颗滚动的珍珠。
pages.enText: An'an filled a mini watering spray with clear water and sprayed the leaves. Droplets rested on green leaves like shiny pearls.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close view: child's hands pump small green spray bottle, misting wide green leaves; sunlight making droplets sparkle.
pages.generationPrompt: Close view: child's hands pump small green spray bottle, misting wide green leaves; sunlight making droplets sparkle.

pages.zhText: 喷到薄荷旁边时，喷头有点松了。安安一晃手，清水从瓶口滴下来，在木地板上积了一小滩。
pages.enText: Beside the mint, the spray top came a little loose. As An'an moved it, water dripped from the bottle onto the wooden floor.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Floor view: small puddle of clear water on wooden floorboards; An'an stands holding watering can, eyes startled.
pages.generationPrompt: Floor view: small puddle of clear water on wooden floorboards; An'an stands holding watering can, eyes startled.

pages.zhText: “哎呀！”天天在旁边喊了一声，“安安把水弄洒啦，老师会不会收走你的小红袖标呀？”
pages.enText: “Uh oh!” Tiantian gasped nearby. “You spilled the water, An'an! Will the teacher take away your helper badge?”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Two-person view: Tiantian looks concerned; An'an bites lip, clutching the green spray bottle, afraid she messed up her duty.

pages.zhText: 安安有点慌，又停了停：“这里有水，先别踩。”她提醒天天，再叫林老师来，一起想办法。
pages.enText: An'an felt worried, then paused. “There is water here. Please do not step in it.” She warned Tiantian and called Teacher Lin to help.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close portrait: An'an pauses, taking a steadying breath; panic giving way to purposeful determination.
pages.generationPrompt: Close portrait: An'an pauses, taking a steadying breath; panic giving way to purposeful determination.

pages.zhText: 老师留在一旁照看。安安把喷壶放稳，慢慢走到卫生角，取来小拖把和干抹布。
pages.enText: The teacher stayed nearby. An'an set the bottle down safely, then walked to fetch a small mop and dry cloths.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Classroom corner: An'an picks up small wooden mop and clean dry cleaning cloth from the neatly organized cleaning rack.

pages.zhText: 她先把抹布铺在水洼最深的地方吸干水分，再用小拖把一下一下，把湿漉漉的地面拖得干干净净、光可鉴人。
pages.enText: She laid the towel over the puddle to soak up the water, then used the mini mop to buff the damp boards dry and shiny.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Low action shot: An'an kneeling smoothly wipes floor with cloth, then mops evenly; floorboards gleam clean without slip hazards.

pages.zhText: 林老师走过来，看见整洁如新的植物角和干爽的地面，蹲下来摸摸安安的头：“安安，你不仅把植物照顾得好，还把意外处理得这么漂亮！”
pages.enText: Teacher Lin walked over. Seeing the clean plant corner and dry floor, she patted An'an's head: “You solved the mishap wonderfully!”

pages.zhText: 午餐前，大家先把手洗干净，再分工准备。天天负责放餐盘，安安负责分发干净的小汤勺。
pages.enText: Before lunch, everyone washed their hands and shared the jobs. Tiantian set out trays, and An'an handed out clean spoons.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Classroom dining scene: small dining tables set up; Tiantian lays trays while An'an carries basket of shiny spoons.

pages.enText: An'an washed her hands thoroughly with soap, held the basket of spoons in both hands, and walked carefully to each table.

pages.enText: Taking each spoon, she held it by the handle, placing the bowl cleanly facing forward beside each child's tray.

pages.enText: “Thank you, An'an!” a younger child joining lunch said. An'an smiled. “You're welcome!” Even setting out spoons could help.

pages.zhText: 听到大家的一声声感谢，安安心里像喝了蜜糖水一样甜滋滋的。胳膊上的小红袖标，在阳光下显得更神气了。
pages.enText: Hearing their thank-yous, An'an's heart felt as sweet as honey. The red helper badge on her sleeve seemed to shine brighter than ever.

pages.enText: Before leaving, An'an and Tiantian sorted stray blocks into storage bins and tucked every small wooden chair neatly under desks.

pages.enText: Returning the armband, An'an received a gold star sticker. “Thank you for caring for our class with Tiantian,” the teacher said. An'an smiled at the little things they had done.

pages.enText: An'an left with a light step. Another friend would be on duty tomorrow, and she could still lend a hand when needed.

parentGuide.goal: 激发大班幼儿作为班级主人的责任感，体会劳动与帮助同伴带来的价值感。
parentGuide.reminder: 鼓励参与日常劳动，不以惩罚手段安排值日。在孩子出现失误时指导补救，保护劳动热情。
questions: 安安给绿萝浇水洒出来时，她是怎么做的？
听到大家说“谢谢安安姐姐”时，安安心里感觉怎样？
parentGuide.activity: 在家里设置一日“家庭小小值日生”，由孩子负责餐前分发筷子或给阳台盆栽喷水。

ageTips.age4to5: 允许孩子用指图、点头、手势等非语言方式表达；共读以倾听、感受安抚为主，不强求马上做到。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论大班一日生活中的真实感受与解决策略，鼓励孩子自己提出小行动，家长承担托底支持与陪伴责任。
